course: Course 3: Programming in C and Python
reviewer_type: AI review with every program compiled and run by tools/run_chapter.py; no human review yet
title: Your First Program, and What Really Happens When It Runs
subtitle: One line of text, followed from your editor through the compiler or the interpreter, down to the single request both programs make to the operating system.
prerequisite_note: Chapter 0's setup: gcc (or clang) and Python 3 working in a terminal.
objectives: Write, compile and run programs that print text and numbers in both languages.
Tell compile-time errors from run-time errors in each language.
Run each stage of a C build and inspect its output.
Read Python bytecode for a small program.
Use exit statuses and command-line arguments.
Explain the speed difference between the two languages on a loop.
